> Thank you for contributing to Tributo Algorithms!
> Remove these instructions before submitting your pull request.
>
> Mark this pull request as a draft if you want early feedback, or ready for review when it is complete.

## Summary

> Briefly describe what this pull request changes and why it is needed. Mention user-facing or API changes when applicable.

## Related issues

> Link related issues, for example: "Fixes #123", "Closes #123", or "Related to #123".

## Validation

> List the relevant checks or tests you ran and their results. Mention checks that are pending, unavailable, or not run.

## Additional information

> Include when applicable:
> - Breaking changes and migration notes
> - New dependencies and license considerations
> - Documentation changes, risks, or known limitations
